name: Victor G. Viramontes
office: Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Eight

items.text: Victor Viramontes is an associate justice of the Second District Court of Appeal, Division Eight, appointed in 2022. He previously worked as national senior counsel at MALDEF and a senior trial attorney at the EEOC. He wrote opinions upholding a $1 million student verdict, letting artists keep deposits after a festival cancellation, and reversing a father's payment order for monitored visits.
